SELECT T.* FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD T
AND TO_CHAR(T.UPTIME, 'YYYY') = #{year} AND TO_CHAR(T.DOWNTIME, 'YYYY') = #{year}
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT R.EQUIPTCATEGORY, SUM(R.USAGETIME) AS USAGETIME, SUM(E.PLANUSETIME) AS PLANUSETIME FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD R, T_CORE_EQUIPT E
R.EQUIPTID = E.ID
AND R.EQUIPTCATEGORY = #{equiptCategory}
AND R.UPTIME > TO_DATE (#{startTime}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
AND R.DOWNTIME < TO_DATE (#{endTime}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
GROUP BY R.EQUIPTCATEGORY

SELECT TO_CHAR(R.UPTIME, 'YYYY-MM') AS UPTIME, SUM(R.USAGETIME) AS USAGETIME, SUM(E.PLANUSETIME) AS PLANUSETIME FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD R, T_CORE_EQUIPT E WHERE R.EQUIPTID = E.ID GROUP BY TO_CHAR(R.UPTIME, 'YYYY-MM')
SELECT TO_CHAR(R.UPTIME, 'YYYY-MM') AS UPTIME, SUM(R.AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD R GROUP BY TO_CHAR(R.UPTIME, 'YYYY-MM')

SELECT R.EQUIPTNAME, R.EQUIPTCATEGORY, R.USAGETIME, TO_CHAR(R.UPTIME, 'YYYY-MM') AS "YEARMONTH", E.PLANUSETIME FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD R, T_CORE_EQUIPT E
R.EQUIPTID = E.ID
AND R.EQUIPTNAME LIKE '%' || #{equiptName} || '%'
AND R.EQUIPTCATEGORY LIKE '%' || #{equiptCategory} || '%'
AND TO_CHAR(R.UPTIME, 'YYYY-MM') = #{date}

SELECT T.EQUIPTNAME, T.EQUIPTCATEGORY, T.SAMPLEQTY, T.ORDERTASKQTY, T.AMOUNT, TO_CHAR(T.UPTIME, 'YYYY-MM') AS "YEARMONTH" FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD T
AND TO_CHAR(T.UPTIME, 'YYYY-MM') = #{date}
